title: EV Charging Stations Near Me: Map and List
description: Find EV charging stations near any place with EV Charging Stations Near Me — mapped from open data, nearest first. Free.
summary_sentence: Results are limited to returned OpenStreetMap records and may omit closer or unmapped places. Confirm details with an authoritative local source.
quick_answer: The tool searches OpenStreetMap for mapped charging station records around a chosen location, then sorts returned records by straight-line distance. It requests at most 200 records and displays up to 100, so it cannot guarantee the closest result or a complete list. Data, access and opening status can be incomplete or outdated.

body.t: Search near a location for mapped charging stations, then verify connectors, access, opening status and availability with the operator.
Moving house with an EV: the neighbourhood's charging map is a moving-in fact as real as the schools.
A second returned station is only a candidate backup; verify compatibility, access and live availability.
A charger you know is missing tells you the local data's vintage — and OpenStreetMap accepts the correction from anyone.
Nearest first sounds obvious until a river intervenes: the closest plug as the crow flies can be a bridge away by road. The list ranks by distance; your route sense refines it.
The list shows a station name and distance, but not connector type, power, prices or operating status. Check the provider before travelling.

faq: Does it show connector types and prices?
No. This workspace shows names, locations and distances, not connector types, prices or live availability. Check the operator.
How current is the data?
As current as the last mapper's edit in that area — days in active cities, longer in quiet ones. A station you find missing can be added to OpenStreetMap by anyone, including you.
Can I use the tool without sharing my precise location?
You can search for a place instead of using device location. The selected search centre is sent to OpenStreetMap-based services for the lookup.
Why might a boundary or place name look different elsewhere?
Place data varies by source and date; charging operators' own maps draw from their networks rather than the open record.
Does MapBench store my browser location?
Device location is optional. The selected coordinates are sent to Overpass to search; consult the privacy page for provider and site details.
The nearest station is across a river or border.
Distance ranking is geographic. Your route may prefer the second entry; the list gives you the order to judge from.
Tesla-only stations included?
The search does not filter or display network access restrictions. Verify compatibility and access with the operator.
Can I plan a full route's charging here?
This finds stations near a point; chain points along your route for the whole journey — the range ring from EV Range Radius frames each hop.
A charger exists but is not listed.
It is unmapped or was mapped after the data snapshot. OpenStreetMap edits flow in — and local knowledge like yours is precisely how the map learns.
Fast chargers specifically?
The workspace does not show or filter by charging power. Verify speed and connector details with the operator.
Free charging points?
Pricing is not shown. Check current costs with the operator.
